## Context

Commit 7fa8102477 (2026-08-08, "Bound malformed overlap judge calls") bounded `judge_batch` with `output_token_limit=1024`, `structured_retry_limit=0`, `transport_attempt_limit=1`, `request_timeout_limit_s=60`. The sibling call site `judge_one` in `src/rebar/llm/overlap/judge.py` — the VOLUME site (~18 of 23 LLM calls in one measured plan review, per the module's own comment) — was not given the same bounds.

Measured consequence (local usage logs, 2026-08-06→08-11): 322 terminal `overlap-judge` failures with `finish_reason=length`, each burning 48,000 output tokens = 3 attempts (pydantic-ai `OUTPUT_RETRIES=2` default) x the 16,000 default `max_tokens` cap, ~$132 of pure waste; 20+ occurrences after the 08-08 fix landed, and 7 more reproduced during replay experiments on 2026-08-11. An overlap verdict is ~100 output tokens, so an unbounded retry ladder buys nothing.

## Plan

Mirror `judge_batch`'s bounds onto `judge_one`'s `RunRequest` (same values, same rationale comment): `output_token_limit=1024`, `structured_retry_limit=0`, `transport_attempt_limit=1`, `request_timeout_limit_s=60`. The overlap step is advisory and already abstains on any error, so tighter bounds cannot change a review verdict — a bounded failure degrades to the same abstain as an unbounded one, at ~2% of the cost.

Add a unit test pinning the bounds on the `judge_one` request (mirroring whatever pins judge_batch's; if none pins judge_batch's, add both in one test module touch).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `judge_one` builds its `RunRequest` with `output_token_limit=1024`, `structured_retry_limit=0`, `transport_attempt_limit=1`, and `request_timeout_limit_s=60`, matching `judge_batch`. Verify: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c "import inspect, rebar.llm.overlap.judge as j; s=inspect.getsource(j.judge_one); assert 'output_token_limit=1024' in s and 'structured_retry_limit=0' in s"` exits 0.
- [ ] A unit test asserts the bounds appear on the request `judge_one` submits (via a stub runner capturing the `RunRequest`). Verify: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -x` passes.
- [ ] An error path still returns the abstain verdict (existing behavior unchanged). Verify: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -x` passes.
